decisions.reason: Having survived a second review cycle in a core upholstery niche, A likely meets the firm's aspiration level, so with available slack we would keep it.

B remains somewhat more uncertain because its market signal is weaker and it overlaps with other decorative fabrics, but continued presence suggests results are not far enough below aspiration to force withdrawal.
C's flame-retardant functionality for hospitality and project customers likely keeps its performance above aspiration relative to comparable offerings, so we would retain it.
D faces more scrutiny as a less prominently featured wool-blend decorative fabric in a portfolio moving toward more sustainable, better-proven lines, but not enough to justify dropping it now.
F is still new and therefore less proven, yet its dedicated presentation and applicability in both upholstery and curtain uses support keeping it while results become clearer.
